class ApiResponse(BaseModel):
    code: int
    msg: str
    data: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None

class DeleteTweetRequest(BaseModel):
    aisa_api_key: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    tweet_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)

    @field_validator('tweet_id', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def normalize_tweet_id(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return value.strip()
